profile_largest_measured_component.name: native Wan Batched-CFG DiT
profile_largest_measured_component.selection_reason: DiT is the largest measured native component; no historical timing is used as a candidate baseline

candidate_description: Add an internal read-only pinned-output view for the existing default Batched-CFG forward path. VideoEngine consumes that pinned velocity before the next forward instead of allocating and copying a std::vector on every denoise step. Preserve the existing copying WanDit::forward_cfg API and all other paths.
implementation_bound: Only WanDit CFG output ownership/readback and VideoEngine's consumption may change; no sampler arithmetic, model precision, CUDA kernel, scheduler semantics, default quality, frame count, public schema, or terminal behavior changes.
schedule: per repetition, seeded arm order; fixed wide,tall,square order within arm
cold_prefix_policy: model loading and one warmup per shape per fresh stage block are reported separately and excluded from warm statistics; no cold-prefix mixing
source_policy: exact frozen real public FLUX.2 PNG bytes from the profile
analysis: retain every observation and IQR outlier; report median/p95/IQR/MAD
